rows.label: Fill out the online application for the FGSS minor
rows.note: The board cannot see applications; confirm it yourself.

rows.label: Three more FGSS courses (one meeting a major focus category, two of your choice)
rows.note: Narrowed to FGSS courses at the 2000 level or above worth 3 or more credits: first-year writing seminars do not count, and five courses must make at least 15 credits. A 1000-level FGSS course that is not a writing seminar would count on the page but is held out here (a false red, not a false green).

rows.label: One of the three extra courses must satisfy a focus category of the FGSS major
rows.note: The categories are defined on the FGSS major page and course membership is not in the roster data; confirm with the FGSS office.

rows.label: No first-year writing seminar among the five courses
rows.note: The pool already starts at the 2000 level, which keeps writing seminars out; confirm none of your five is one.

rows.label: Contract-college students: one non-FGSS course from your major may count among the five, by DUS petition
rows.note: Students in a contract college may petition the FGSS director of undergraduate studies to let a single non-FGSS course from their major stand in among the five; the board cannot see petitions, so confirm it yourself if you use one.
